QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] Informant
QuestInfo.0: You confirmed the stronghold can be infiltrated. Talk with #bChief Alex#k in #bHenesys Ruins#k about what to do next.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Alex has an informant that used this method to infiltrate the Knight Stronghold. He should be around #bKnight District 2#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met the informant that infiltrated the Knight Stronghold. According to him, the corrupted Empress has remained hidden, and the knights are just blindly following her commands.

0.0: Do you remember me telling you that the method to infiltrate the Knight Stronghold was used before? An informant used it to get in.

yes.0: The informant should be around #bKnight District 2#k. Look carefully--with his disguise, he'll be hard to tell apart from the other knights.

no.0: It's a dangerous job, but you're the only one who can do it.

0.1: Enter the stronghold and find the informant. Make sure he's okay, and see if he has any news to report.

npc.0: The informant should be around #bKnight District 2#k. Look carefully--with his disguise, he'll be hard to tell apart from the other knights.

quest.0: This is the Knight Stronghold. Be cautious of the knights and eliminate any enemies you find.
